tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Harnack inequality] 1. ch8:8.20\group ch08-generalized-solutions Assume (8.5) and (8.6). If $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ is nonnegative and $Lu=0$, then for every $B_{4R}(y)\subset \Omega $, egin{equation} \sup _{B_R(y)}u\leq C\inf _{B_R(y)}u, ag {8.63} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\Lambda /\lambda , u R)$. One may take $C\leq C_0^{\Lambda /\lambda + u R}$ with $C_0=C_0(n)$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 8.17 to control the supremum by a positive $L^p$ norm, and Theorem 8.18 to control that norm by the infimum.

□
